audience: field service and facilities teams that log service requests, equipment and contracts in BlueFolder

useCases.title: Look up a customer's open service requests
useCases.text: Look up a customer, then list their open service requests. Open one request to read its items, labor and billing totals.

useCases.title: Check equipment service dates before a visit
useCases.text: List the equipment of one customer. Open one unit to read its service dates and notes.

useCases.title: Review service contracts and their balances
useCases.text: List the service contracts by customer or status. Open one contract to read its balances, billing details and limits.

useCases.title: Read the history of a service request
useCases.text: Read the history and comments of one service request, by its id or its external id.

useCases.title: Log a new job and its comments
useCases.text: Create a service request for a customer and add comments to it. Customer emails are sent only when notifyCustomer is set to true.
